newsitem.title: UK: Danka shareholders approve Kodak deal.
newsitem.headline: Danka shareholders approve Kodak deal.

text.p: Danka Business Systems Plc said its shareholders approved its plan to buy U.S. group Eastman Kodak Co's Office Imaging business.
Florida-based Danka said in September it would buy the Kodak unit for $684 million in a move that was expected to put it in a leading position in the fastest-growing segment of its market.
Danka said on Thursday it had signed a $1.275 billion credit facility to finance the purchase.

Under the acquisition, Danka agreed to buy the sales, marketing and equipment service operations of Kodak's Office Imaging business, as well as Kodak's facilities management business known as Kodak Imaging Services, Danka said in a statement released here.
Danka's shares rose 12.5p to 577.5p by 1310 GMT.
